test_cases.name: Export Markdown report (default current-dir output)
test_cases.expected: Prints the generated .md path; file has title, header row (文件系统名称/文件系统ID/状态/协议/容量(GB)/可用区/类型/企业项目/创建时间) + one row per file system

test_cases.name: Explicit output path
test_cases.expected: Markdown file written to the given path

test_cases.name: Name / status filters
test_cases.expected: Only matching file systems rendered (both filters applied client-side)

test_cases.name: Empty result still writes a Markdown file
test_cases.expected: Header + '无 SFS 文件系统' note written, exit 0, no error

test_cases.name: Argument help (syntax)
test_cases.expected: argparse help printed (region / output / name / status), exit 0

notes: 只读操作（ListShares），无资源创建/修改/删除风险；Markdown 仅在本机生成，绝不写回云端。CLI 主路径使用 hcloud SFSTurbo ListShares（只读 GET /v1/{project_id}/sfs-turbo/shares/detail）；SDK 回退使用 huaweicloudsdksfsturbo v1；SDK 依赖缺失时可运行 scripts/ensure_env.py 自动安装。缺 hcloud 后端/凭据时用例按后端可用性降级或跳过，不产生伪失败；真实只读验证由 QA 带外执行。
